events.title: Play the PROCEDURE ZERO Demo in Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Steam Next Fest is on, and the free PROCEDURE ZERO demo is part of it from October 19 to 26. You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners here quietly disappear, and you're next on the list. The demo covers the first two missions, about 25 minutes of play: hide from the guards, lure them away with a radio, trade cigarettes for codes and keep your stash under your bunk. events.title: PROCEDURE ZERO demo gameplay live — Steam Next Fest
events.summary: All through Steam Next Fest (October 19–26), the whole PROCEDURE ZERO demo plays on loop right here on the store page — a first-person stealth game set in a prison where inmates quietly disappear. At the end of every loop there's a short look beyond the demo: footage from the full game, which launches on November 12. Play the free demo (about 25 minutes, 23 languages) and add PROCEDURE ZERO to your wishlist!

events.title: PROCEDURE ZERO Launches November 12
events.summary: PROCEDURE ZERO has a release date: November 12, 2026. The demo ends at the gate to the isolation wing. On November 12, it opens. First-person stealth set against a prison conspiracy. You were an auditor who found a second register. Now you are in cell C-17 with status ZERO, and someone has started erasing you from the files.
